title: Benefit Schedule for Hotel Stays: Wanderlane Traveller Club Tiers
content:
This section of the Wanderlane Traveller Club benefit schedule states the named benefits a tier grants on hotel stays. Guaranteed late checkout records whether the tier grants it. The room-upgrade queue position is the member's position in the room-upgrade queue, where 1 is served first and 0 means the tier is not queued at all.

## The schedule

| Basis | Blue | Silver | Gold | Platinum | Titanium | Ambassador |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Guaranteed late checkout | No | No | Yes | Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Room-upgrade queue position | 0 | 0 | 4 | 3 | 2 | 1 |

## Reading of the schedule

Guaranteed late checkout is granted from Wanderlane Gold upward, and is not granted at Wanderlane Blue or Wanderlane Silver.

The queue position runs in the opposite direction to the tier: Wanderlane Ambassador holds position 1 and is served first, Wanderlane Titanium position 2, Wanderlane Platinum position 3 and Wanderlane Gold position 4. Wanderlane Blue and Wanderlane Silver stand at 0 and are not queued.
